crossRefs.note: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.
Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;
for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.
My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding,
that you may maintain discretion, that your lips may preserve knowledge.
My words will utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they will speak sincerely.
My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart will utter understanding.
You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!

translations.web: If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”
translations.bsb: But if not, then listen to me; be quiet, and I will teach you wisdom.”
translations.kjv: If not, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I shall teach thee wisdom.
translations.asv: If not, hearken thou unto me: Hold thy peace, and I will teach thee wisdom.
